name: De Vasa's Hexagonal Chess
author: Helge E. de Vasa (1953) / AGP port
description: Hexagonal chess turned 90 degrees: an 81-cell rhombus with orderly horizontal ranks, so a pawn has TWO forward moves and captures only on the two side diagonals. Gliński's piece moves, castling in two lengths (king 2 cells short, 3 long) — and the kings start on opposite wings.
